UPDATE step_runs SET status = $3, ended_at = $4, elapsed_ms = $5, output = $6, output_text = $7,
                    messages = $8, session_content = $9, human_error = $10, technical_error = $11,
                    skipped_reason = $12, updated_at = now()
             WHERE id = $1 AND status = $2
